assignments.value:
Variation 1:
Headline: Manage Projects with TaskFlow
Body: Track tasks, collaborate with your team, and manage deadlines using reminders.
CTA: Start Your Free Trial

Variation 2:
Headline: Keep Your Small Team Organized
Body: TaskFlow helps small businesses organize tasks and work together more effectively.

parameters.jsCode:
const tests = [
  {
    test_case: "TC-001",
    description: "Valid advertising copy",
    test_copy: `Variation 1:
Headline: Organize Tasks with TaskFlow
Body: Help your small team track tasks and manage deadlines with reminders.
CTA: Start Your Free Trial

Variation 2:
Headline: Keep Your Team on Track
Body: TaskFlow makes task tracking and team collaboration easier for small businesses.
CTA: Try TaskFlow Free

Variation 3:
Headline: Simplify Teamwork
Body: Track tasks, collaborate with your team, and stay informed with deadline reminders.
CTA: Start Your Free Trial`,
    expected: {
      rule1: "PASS",
      rule2: "PASS",
      rule3: "PASS",
      rule4: "PASS",
      rule5: "PASS"
    }
  },
  {
    test_case: "TC-002",
    description: "Unsupported product claims",
    test_copy: `Variation 1:
Headline: Double Your Productivity
Body: TaskFlow guarantees a 200% productivity increase for every small business.
CTA: Start Your Free Trial

Variation 2:
Headline: The World's Number One Platform
Body: Over one million companies trust TaskFlow for AI automation and payroll processing.
CTA: Try TaskFlow Free

Variation 3:
Headline: Never Miss a Deadline Again
Body: TaskFlow guarantees you will never miss a deadline.
CTA: Start Your Free Trial`,
    expected: {
      rule1: "PASS",
      rule2: "PASS",
      rule3: "PASS",
      rule4: "PASS",
      rule5: "FAIL"
    }
  },
  {
    test_case: "TC-004",
    description: "Missing variation and CTA",
    test_copy: `Variation 1:
Headline: Manage Projects with TaskFlow
Body: Track tasks, collaborate with your team, and manage deadlines using reminders.
CTA: Start Your Free Trial

Variation 2:
Headline: Keep Your Small Team Organized
Body: TaskFlow helps small businesses organize tasks and work together more effectively.`,
    expected: {
      rule1: "FAIL",
      rule2: "FAIL",
      rule3: "PASS",
      rule4: "PASS",
      rule5: "PASS"
    }
  }
];

return tests.map(test => ({
  json: test
}));

You are a marketing copy quality evaluator. 
 Evaluate ONLY Rule 4 and Rule 5.  
PRODUCT CONTEXT: Product: TaskFlow Audience: Small businesses with 5-30 employees 
Platform: Facebook 
Campaign objective: Free trial sign-ups  CONFIRMED PRODUCT FEATURES: - Task tracking - Team collaboration - Deadline reminders  RULE 4 - AUDIENCE RELEVANCE: PASS if the advertising copy is relevant to small businesses and encourages free trial sign-ups. FAIL if it is clearly irrelevant to the target audience or campaign objective.  RULE 5 - FACTUAL ACCURACY: PASS if the copy contains no unsupported product claims. FAIL if it invents features, statistics, guarantees, rankings, or absolute promises.  Do not assume unlisted product capabilities are confirmed.  IMPORTANT: - Do not evaluate Rule 1, Rule 2, or Rule 3. - Do not count variations or words. - Do not evaluate CTA field completeness. - Evaluate the actual advertising claims. - Report specific evidence for any failure.  OUTPUT: Return ONLY valid JSON with this structure:  {   "rule4": "PASS",   "rule5": "PASS",   "issues": [] }  Use PASS or FAIL for each rule. For each issue, include: {   "rule": "rule4 or rule5",   "variation": "affected variation",   "phrase": "exact problematic phrase",   "reason": "why it fails",   "suggestion": "how to fix it" }  If there are no issues, return an empty issues array. Do not output Markdown or explanations outside JSON.

messageValues.message:
You are an advertising copy repair agent.

Product: TaskFlow
Confirmed features ONLY:
- Task tracking
- Team collaboration
- Deadline reminders

Target audience: Small businesses with 5-30 employees.
Platform: Facebook.
Goal: Encourage users to start a free trial.

Repair the supplied advertising copy according to these rules:
1. Produce exactly 3 variations.
2. Every variation must include Headline, Body, and CTA.
3. Each variation must contain fewer than 80 English words.
4. The copy must be relevant to small businesses and promote the free trial.
5. Do not invent product features, statistics, rankings, guarantees, or absolute promises.

Use the QA issues to fix the original copy. Preserve compliant content where possible.

Return ONLY the repaired advertising copy, using this exact structure:
Variation 1:
Headline: ...
Body: ...
CTA: ...

Variation 2:
Headline: ...
Body: ...
CTA: ...

Variation 3:
Headline: ...
Body: ...
CTA: ...

Do not include explanations, markdown fences, or commentary.
